items.title: Missing the Sea
items.text:
Missing the Sea: Lose 1 action if you begin your turn
in a location that is not a port (anchor).

mechanics.trigger: If you begin your turn in a location that is not a port
restrictions: The location is not a port

items.title: Embezzler
items.text:
Embezzler: When you do the Make Supplies action,
also move a cube from the stockpile into the reserve.

mechanics.trigger: When you do the Make Supplies action
mechanics.effect: Also move a cube from the stockpile into the reserve.

items.title: Disoriented
items.text:
Disoriented: When you do the Chart Sea Lane action,
you must spend 1 more Supply cube.

mechanics.trigger: When you do the Chart Sea Lane action
mechanics.effect: You must spend 1 more Supply cube.

items.title: SCARS
items.text:
SCARS
Add these to your pool of scars.

mechanics.effect: Add these stickers to the pool of scars.

summary: Three scars for the pool: Missing the Sea (lose 1 action when you start inland; the port mark is an anchor), Embezzler (Make Supplies also moves a cube from the stockpile into the reserve), and Disoriented (Chart Sea Lane costs 1 more Supply cube). The SCARS label is byte-identical to door 48.
